title: Jessica G NDE 3972
content: This incident occurred at the end of a long period of abuse - about three years. My abuser isolated me while I was swimming in a pond behind his house. After a brief argument with the man, as I was trying to swim away from him, he pushed me underwater by my shoulders and held me there. I struggled against his hands on my shoulders, but was not able to come to the surface. When I was almost out of air, I looked up through the water at the face of my attacker. His expression was very frightening to me because he was smiling, but also appeared to be very angry. The perspective of my memory at that point changed from looking up at him to looking down at the top and back of his head and myself from above. I saw my body floating limply under water with my eyes open. At the same time the visual perspective of my memory changed, I remember the pain in my lungs, my feelings of panic and the urge to breathe stopped as well. I felt peaceful clarity. I was aware of the circumstances and knew I was dying. My face looked peaceful and oddly pretty. I was aware I had a choice and was happy to move on to the light behind me. The light looked like a very bright full moon. I felt a strange tug as I moved away from my body toward the light. It felt like an involuntary gasp. Then, I realized my little sister needed me so I had to come back. I came back into my body and it hurt. All the feelings of panic were gone, but my chest was burning. I knew from looking at the scene from above, that he was just pushing me under, not holding onto me. I swam/sunk downward and backwards away from him on my back. He couldn't see through the water because it was very muddy and murky at the bottom. I came up under a floating dock in the middle of the pond and hid there until he left.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: She reported a 'strange tug' moving away from her body and that it 'felt like an involuntary gasp.'

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She decided to return after realizing her little sister needed her, and then 'came back into my body.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Attempted drowning during an assault by an abuser who pushed her underwater and held her there.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred during drowning, followed by awareness of a bright light behind her and movement toward it, then a decision to return to her body due to her sister.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: She reported that as the visual perspective changed to above her body, the pain/panic/urge to breathe stopped and she felt peaceful clarity.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: She described the light 'like a very bright full moon' and noted that during the OBE she knew the attacker was only pushing her under (not holding on), which informed her escape strategy.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt peaceful clarity. I was aware of the circumstances and knew I was dying.”
